SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image AS coverImage, a.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, a.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS authorName, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.is_published AS isPublished, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime FROM test.blog_article a LEFT JOIN test.blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN test.blog_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.is_published = 1
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM test.blog_article_tag at WHERE at.article_id = a.id AND at.tag_id = #{tagId} )
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image AS coverImage, a.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, a.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS authorName, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.is_published AS isPublished, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime, a.attachments FROM test.blog_article a LEFT JOIN test.blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN test.blog_user u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
